title: sqlalchemy.exc.DatabaseError: (cx_Oracle.DatabaseError) DPI-1043: invalid number

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Describe the bug

sqlalchemy.exc.DatabaseError: (cx_Oracle.DatabaseError) DPI-1043: invalid number

### To Reproduce

```python
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, String, DateTime, Column
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy import Column, String, Integer, Text
from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey, Sequence, MetaData, Table
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship, sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.ext.horizontal_shard import ShardedSession, ShardedQuery
from sqlalchemy import Enum
import os
import uuid
import datetime
import enum


# 初始化数据库链接
engine = create_engine('oracle+cx_oracle://user:pwd@host:1521/enfo', pool_recycle=600, pool_pre_ping=True, echo=True)
# 创建对象的基类
md = MetaData(bind=engine)  # 引用MetaData
Base = declarative_base(metadata = md)

def global_id():
    return str(uuid.uuid4()).replace('-','')

class BaseStatusEnum(enum.Enum):
    available = 1
    deleted = 2

class user_menuaccess(Base):
    # 表的名字
    __tablename__ = 'user_menuaccess'
    _id = Column(String(32), nullable=False, primary_key=True, default=global_id, comment="主键")
    _create_time = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True, default=datetime.datetime.now, comment="创建时间")
    _update_time = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, index=True, default=datetime.datetime.now, onupdate=datetime.datetime.now,
                             comment="更新时间")
    _operator = Column(String(32), nullable=True, index=True, comment="更新者")
    _status = Column(Enum(BaseStatusEnum), key="status", nullable=False, index=True, default=BaseStatusEnum.available,comment="记录状态,available代表可用,deleted代表已删除")
    _version = Column("_version", Integer, nullable=False,info={"version_meta": True}, default=1,comment="当前版本号")
    user_id = Column(String(32), comment="用户的ID")
    menu_id = Column(String(32), comment="菜单ID")
    accesscount = Column(Integer, comment="用户点击菜单的次数")
    __mapper_args__ = {
        "version_id_col": _version
    }


Session = sessionmaker(twophase=True, class_=ShardedSession)
shards = {'test': engine}

def shard_chooser(mapper, instance, clause=None, **kw):
    """"""
    return 'test'

def id_chooser(query, identity):
    """"""
    return ['test']

def execute_chooser(orm_context):
    """"""
    return ['test']

Session.configure(shards=shards, shard_chooser=shard_chooser, id_chooser=id_chooser,
                        execute_chooser=execute_chooser, query_cls=ShardedQuery)
session = Session()

obj = user_menuaccess(user_id='1', menu_id='2', accesscount=1)
session.add(obj)
session.flush()
obj.accesscount = 2
session.commit()
```
